build_FiDT5_model: build a Fusion-in-Decoder T5 model by instantiating FiDT5 with a T5 config
generate_FiDT5_outputs: generate text from a FiDT5 model using batched multi-passage input IDs and attention masks
extract_crossattention_scores: extract cross-attention scores from a FiDT5 decoder to compute passage similarity for a retriever
load_T5_weights_into_FiDT5: load pretrained T5 weights into a FiDT5 model using the load_t5 method with a state dict
build_Retriever_model: build a BERT-based retriever model that computes similarity scores between questions and passages
